name: Dongnam Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1965 and headquartered in Gongju, South Korea, Dongnam Chemical Co., Ltd. is a producer and supplier of various chemical products and surface-active agents within the country. The company's diverse offerings include nonionic, cationic, anionic, and amphoteric surfactants. Before adopting its current name in March 2004, the firm was known as Dongnam Industry Co., Ltd.
